programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into the Skies"
programme.desc: Growth in air transportation is set to soar, carrying over 10 billion passengers every year by 2050. To cope requires us to radically rethink aircraft design. Join us as we look into the world's most innovative research and development labs.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into Space"
programme.desc: The most innovative area of human motion lies not on Earth, but with the exploration of space. Meet the private space entrepreneurs jostling to offer the tantalizing prospect of cheap, frequent travel beyond the atmosphere into Earth orbit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ruling The Waves"
programme.desc: From the most deadly submarines ever seen to the infamous destroyers of the Second World War, this episode is the story of what it takes to rule the waves.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Conqeuring The Sky"
programme.desc: The evolution of mankind's desire to fly higher, move faster, and kill better all from within the cockpit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ultimate Annihilation"
programme.desc: Explore the destructive capability of machinery across all scales, the inventions designed to unleash maximum carnage, then and now.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Waterford"
programme.desc: Francesca finds out how the world famous Waterford crystal is made and gets to try out glass blowing and glass cutting with surprising results.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Helicopters"
programme.desc: In this episode of Ultimate Processes, we investigate how the AW 101, one of the world’s most advanced search and rescue helicopters is designed and built.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Asteroid or Alien Tech?"
programme.desc: It was discovered on October 19th, 2017 and it was recognized as the first known object of its type. It is unique since it is the first known object that came from our solar system. But while we observed it, the mystery surrounding it grew.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Apollo Sale"
programme.desc: Torie’s son Jason joins her on the road. Larry turns ‘gastronaut’ when he comes across some space food; and a collector’s flash sale sees Cole bid for an Apollo 11 item with an incredible story.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Good Luck, Bad Luck"
programme.desc: Cole gets lucky when he finds a Russian space suit in an old box, but the gloves are missing. To find the gloves he has to strike a deal with Larry. Torie hears how Coke and Pepsi joined the space race and meets former NASA astronaut Winston Scott.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Eastern Front 1941-45"
programme.desc: The text addresses the conflict between Hitler's Luftwaffe and the Soviet Air Force, highlighting that despite initial outclassing, Stalin's pilots eventually achieved parity with Allied assistance.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot"
programme.desc: The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot was an aerial battle in the Western Pacific where the U.S. successfully shot down over 300 Japanese aircraft with a 12-1 kill-to-loss ratio.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
programme.desc: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
programme.sub-title: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programme.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programme.sub-title: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programme.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
programme.desc: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "The Humanoid Robots"
programme.desc: They look, they move like us and soon they will live among us. They are humanoid robots.Meet an astonishing group of humanoids,among them: iCub,the world's first baby robot and REEM,the Service Robot,ready to be launched as a guide in public spaces.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Bioinspired Robots"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at a robotic plant that mimics the mechanics of plant roots, and dive underwater to see robots inspired by fish.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "City of the Future"
programme.desc: By the year 2050, three qarters of the world's population will live in urban areas. Looking at robotic systems being developed worlwide we can take a glimpse at the city life of the future.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Robot Explorers"
programme.desc: Inhospitable environments that would normally be unreacheble become accessible thanks to Robot Explorers. Robots can help us in difficult tasks but is there any danger in letting machines handle so many tasks that used to belong to us?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Coup In Crimea"
programme.desc: The Crimea Annexation in February 2014 was the biggest and most blatant land grab in Europe since WWII and shook the very foundations upon which peace in the region had been based ever since. How did Russia execute the annexation?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Yemen Britain & The Saudis"
programme.desc: In March 2019 news reports appeared in the British press of UK’s troops being killed in Yemen, no one knew why they are there in the first place. Britain was not fighting a war in Yemen. This episode investigates the truth behind the casualties.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "German Aviation"
programme.desc: The untold secret story of war production that shaped the Second World War, beginning with how the German aviation industry came to dominate the skies of Europe.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Krupp"
programme.desc: The story behind the Krupp company, who were responsible for the manufacture of two of Germany's most feared war products - the Panzer Tank and the U-boat.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Vickers"
programme.desc: The role played by engineering giant Vickers during the Second World War, including the development of the Spitfire and how the Royal Navy recovered from losing so many warships.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "Bomber Offensive: Target Germany"
programme.desc: This review examines the effects of Allied bombing raids on German industry, air defense, and morale during the European skies conflict, including the US's development of long-range fighters.
